decisions.reason: The same-message FAQ MODIFY already states that a no-referral mint sends the commission and Small and Big Block tickets to a random existing NFT holder.
The same-message MODIFY already records that no-referral mints generate tickets, while the existing state identifies the applicable Small and Big Block ticket counters.
The source changes the recipient of rewards on no-referral mints, not the mint price, commission amount, founder allocation, or prize-pool funding allocation.
Allocating a Small Block ticket on a no-referral mint does not change the Small Block winner count, prize amount, pool funding, or draw condition.
The no-referral reward allocation does not change which referral, ticket-counter, or badge attributes must be displayed in NFT metadata.
Allocating a Big Block ticket on a no-referral mint does not change the Big Block winner count, prize amount, pool target, funding sources, or draw trigger.
Randomly selecting the recipient of rewards from a no-referral mint is distinct from selecting prize-draw winners through Chainlink VRF and does not alter that requirement.
The source concerns primary mints without referral codes and does not change secondary-sale royalties, their allocation, or the rule that secondary sales create no referral tickets.
Issuing tickets and commission to a random holder on a no-referral mint does not change the manual one-click prize collection flow.
The source does not change badge milestones, storage, approved badge designs, icons, or current badge effects.
The no-referral reward allocation is unrelated to the deferred Discord community server.
The source does not change the Transak provider, fiat conversion, supported payment methods, or wallet requirement for fiat minting.
